title: [dist-txns] CassandraSecondaryIndex write throughput drops gradually
body:
Using commit [2ebadb8](https://github.com/YugaByte/yugabyte-db/commit/2ebadb87f00177ee9d5a37ee5f814722a7456091), write throughput of CassandraSecondaryIndex workload drops gradually over time.
